posts.text:
Thank goodness your wife is well, my friend. 

Talking down our fantastic country is what the left does.  We’re surrounded by the wonders of our society.  God help us if this attitude becomes normalized in the conservative movement. But it explains a lot. 

Fwiw, I’d be blind in my left eye but for the incredible advances in medicine. One shot every 6 weeks. I’d problem be dead from severe heart disease as well.
posts.summary: Opposes negative characterization of America, warns against normalization in conservative movement
